pages.text: Now and then a sniffer turns up $(item)Duskbloom Seeds$(), from a crop that kept the lantern's hours long before the lantern did.$(br2)Plant them in farmland. They grow only $(l)at night$(), or anywhere with no sky to keep time by. Ripe, the plant opens and glows faintly, and gives $(item)Duskbloom Petals$() and seeds.

pages.title: What petals make
pages.text: Crafted alone, light blue dye. A day in a kiln under a clear sunny sky dries them; two dried petals in a water bottle make $(item)Duskbloom Tea$(), a minute of night sight.$(br2)Stirred into Preserved Berries they make $(item)Duskbloom Jam$(). And a dried petal left under the night sky for two weeks hardens into a $(item)Slowlight Shard$().
